verdict.rationale: Quo generates AI insights from in-product data: recorded calls are transcribed and summarized, AI call tags are listed as a feature, and summaries attach to call records (Business and Scale plans only). The MCP summary feature runs in an external agent rather than inside the product, so it is not credited here. missing for 10: AI suggestions or recommended actions, insights beyond per-call summaries and tags (e.g., cross-conversation analytics), availability on all plans, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized, so no detail is missed and nobody has to take notes.
Call summaries are only available on business and scale plans.
